claims.claim: Definition of material change (change in business, operations or capital reasonably expected to have a significant effect on market price or value)
claims.quote: a change in the business, operations or capital of the reporting issuer that would reasonably be expected to have a significant effect on the market price or value of any of the securities of the reporting issuer

claims.claim: Material change also includes a board decision, or a senior-management decision where board confirmation is believed probable, to implement such a change (limb (b))
claims.quote: senior management of the reporting issuer who believe that confirmation of the decision by the board of directors or any other persons acting in a similar capacity is probable

claims.claim: Limb (b) covers a decision to implement a change made by the board of directors
claims.quote: a decision to implement a change referred to in paragraph (a) made by the board of directors

claims.claim: On a material change the issuer must immediately issue and file a news release
claims.quote: immediately issue and file a news release authorized by an executive officer disclosing the nature and substance of the change

claims.claim: Material change report must be filed as soon as practicable and in any event within 10 days
claims.quote: as soon as practicable, and in any event within 10 days of the date on which the change occurs, file a Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report

claims.claim: Under the exception, the issuer files the report marked confidential with written reasons for non-disclosure
claims.quote: immediately files the report required under paragraph (1)(b) marked so as to indicate that it is confidential, together with written reasons for non-disclosure
